purpose: Reference: which logger columns each exercise uses. Derived from hybrid-engine-exercise-library-120 plus profile rules. Core S&C engines deleted 2026-09-03 — this fixture is UI/column metadata only.

load.label: Load
load.when: External mass on the bar, stack, belt, or carry. Stored on performed_set as load.

rpe.label: RPE
rpe.when: Derived from logger RIR on the last planned set (RPE = 10 − RIR). Drives load progression.

rir.label: RIR
rir.when: Logger UI field on last set; converted to rpe for engine storage.

duration.label: Duration
duration.when: Cardio intervals, planks, carries — time under work.

rest.label: Rest
rest.when: Prescribed rest between sets (builder), not always logged per set.

pain.label: Pain
pain.when: Safety flag on exposure; blocks calibration when pain_blocked.

tempo.label: Tempo
tempo.when: Prescription metadata; rarely logged per set today.

watts.label: Watts
watts.when: Cardio machines (future); not in strength logger yet.

reps_load.description: Strength sets — reps plus optional external load or %WM.

duration_distance.description: Cardio — time and/or distance (Assault bike, rower, jump rope).

distance_time_load.description: Loaded carries — load + distance only (non-timed). Library mode name is legacy; no prescribed time column.

time_or_reps.description: Isometrics — hold for time or log reps (planks).

reps_or_time.description: Prep / mobility — reps or timed drill.

self_scaled_reps.label: Self-scaled — reps + difficulty
self_scaled_reps.note: TRX / suspension: resistance from body angle, not kg.

cardio_duration_distance.label: Cardio — duration + distance
cardio_duration_distance.note: Logged via conditioning logger, not strength one-set logger.

carry_distance_load.label: Carry — load + distance (non-timed)
carry_distance_load.note: Distance effort only — no prescribed time. Adaptive Open/Next/Close must not touch carries (same seal as timed holds).

reps_load: If bodyweight calisthenic (pull-up, dip, push-up, nordic, …) without external equipment → bodyweight_reps
If main barbell compound (squat, bench, deadlift, press, oly) → main_pct_wm
Else → accessory_kg_reps (rows, curls, machines, unilateral work)

adapter_divergences.issue: REP_PROGRESSION_NAME matches curl → misclassified as bodyweight rep on main
Adapter rep-progression regex includes rows/carries; many should log kg
library tracking_mode reps_load but movement is bodyweight-dominant

anti_patterns.mistake: Use one regex for all reps_load exercises
anti_patterns.correct: Resolve profile from movement + equipment; map to metrics explicitly

anti_patterns.mistake: Prescribe TRX or suspension work in kg
Store RIR as rir metric in engine
anti_patterns.correct: Logger rir → performed measurement rpe (10 − RIR)
